note: Org names sourced from NYU's own school-level directories (Stern, Tandon, Steinhardt, CLACS Latinx/Latin American student org guide) as of Aug 2026. This is a smaller curated set (25 orgs) rather than an exhaustive directory -- built specifically to demonstrate the multi-university architecture, not to be a complete NYU club directory. Individually reasoned tags, not category-default.

orgs.name: African Students Union
orgs.description: Community and cultural programming for NYU students of African descent and those interested in African culture.

orgs.name: Black Student Union
orgs.description: Community, advocacy, and cultural programming for Black students at NYU.

orgs.name: Caribbean Student Association
orgs.description: Celebrates Caribbean culture and builds community among Caribbean and diaspora students at NYU.

orgs.name: Mexican Student Association
orgs.description: Community and cultural programming for NYU students connected to Mexican heritage.

orgs.name: Puerto Rican Student Association
orgs.description: Community and cultural programming for NYU students connected to Puerto Rican heritage.

orgs.name: Native American and Indigenous Student Group
orgs.description: Community and cultural space for Native American and Indigenous students at NYU.

orgs.name: Muslim Students Association
orgs.description: Community space for NYU students to learn about and practice Islam together.

orgs.name: NYU Ballroom & Latin Dance
orgs.description: Ballroom and Latin dance team performing and competing across NYU and the wider collegiate dance circuit.

orgs.name: Ritmo: Urban Latin Dance Club
orgs.description: Urban Latin dance team blending hip-hop and Latin dance styles.

orgs.name: Finance Society
orgs.description: Educates members on skills integral to a successful career in finance.

orgs.name: International Business Association
orgs.description: Promotes global thinking and helps students find careers at international organizations.

orgs.name: Investment Analysis Group
orgs.description: Manages NYU's only undergraduate student-run investment portfolio.

orgs.name: Entrepreneurial Exchange Group
orgs.description: Offers speakers and workshops for students with entrepreneurial interests to learn, network, and be inspired.

orgs.name: Luxury and Retail Association
orgs.description: Dedicated to forging ties between students and the luxury and retail industries.

orgs.name: NYU Stern Student Council
orgs.description: Official student governing body of NYU Stern, running social programming like Casino Night and the Stern Talent Show.

orgs.name: Tandon Consulting Club
orgs.description: Student-driven consulting club offering case practice and industry exposure for NYU Tandon students.

orgs.name: Tau Beta Pi
orgs.description: The oldest engineering honor society in the US, honoring academic achievement and integrity among engineering students.

orgs.name: American Institute of Chemical Engineers (AIChE)
orgs.description: Student chapter connecting NYU Tandon chemical engineering students with the broader chemical engineering community.

orgs.name: Design for America NYU
orgs.description: Interdisciplinary student club using design thinking to tackle real-world community challenges.

orgs.name: Theta Tau
orgs.description: Professional engineering fraternity focused on leadership, service, and brotherhood among engineering students.

orgs.name: Alpha Omega Epsilon
orgs.description: Professional and social sorority promoting friendship, leadership, and professionalism among students in engineering and technical fields.

orgs.name: Applied Psychology Undergraduate Club
orgs.description: Student-run club exploring psychology outside the classroom through professional development, social engagement, and community service.

orgs.name: ASL Club
orgs.description: Dedicated to Deaf culture and American Sign Language, supporting ASL learners and the Deaf community at NYU.

orgs.name: WNYU
orgs.description: NYU's student-run radio station, broadcasting music, talk, and campus coverage.

orgs.name: NYU Program Board
orgs.description: Student-run organization producing NYU's major campus-wide events, including the annual Strawberry Festival.
